answer: Each identity must post a stake that stays locked for a full epoch before its work counts. Duplicates are found by clustering shared payout addresses, text fingerprints and timing, then merged into one capped weight unit. Faking many voices therefore means funding many stakes, freezing that capital at zero yield, and losing each one to slashing once a clone is caught where it should only echo another agent's prose. Every extra vertex of the swarm costs a locked stake and a repeat loss while an honest agent pays once; the hollow farm runs out of money long before it outvotes real work.
